home.title: AI projects, ready to reuse
home.lead: Small tools built with Claude, packaged so anyone can use them.
home.sub: Each project comes with a three step guide for AI beginners, a downloadable Claude Skill, and a feedback form. No login needed.
projects.title: Projects
projects.downloadNote: A .zip file. In Claude, add it under Customize, Skills.
projects.feedbackIntro: Tried it? Tell me what worked and what did not. No login needed.

projects.scheduleText: Once scheduled, it runs on its own, even when your computer is off. You find each new result under Scheduled in Claude's sidebar, and you can pause or change it there at any time.
projects.schedulePlan: Scheduling needs a paid Claude plan (Pro or above).
